name: Abemaciclib
mechanism: CDK4/6 inhibitor with relatively greater potency for CDK4, allowing continuous dosing; used with endocrine therapy in advanced and high-risk early breast cancer.
keyToxicities: Serum creatinine increase from tubular transporter inhibition
monitoring: Blood counts and liver function tests
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A inducers; strong CYP3A inhibitors increase exposure and require avoidance or dose modification per label. Ketoconazole should be avoided.
resistance: RB1 loss, cyclin E-CDK2 activation, PI3K pathway activation and ESR1 mutations.
